annotations.title: Check whether a phone supports eSIM

description: Use this before recommending a purchase when it is not certain the traveller's phone takes an eSIM, e.g. "does my iPhone 13 work?", "Galaxy A54 eSIM?". Returns GlobalPass's compatibility note for the model family and the check that settles it on the phone itself (an EID line in the settings).

language.description: Language of the answer: en, pl or ru.

name: check_device
title: Check whether a phone supports eSIM
